response.overview: Those who had been excluded and marginalized in this society burst out of the shadows into the streets after the night of the martial law declaration. Many people were very curious about where these people had suddenly come from. Among them, someone asked to be called a "queer feminist" rather than a "light stick citizen." Then the queer feminist came to the workers and became a 'wasp'. "Let us meet as the same working class." The wasp became a worker,  and a comrade. Now, the wasps fight together to protect struggling workers, to change the world together.
